- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1/2 cup milk
- 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley

2. Add Parmesan and Romano cheeses, flour, salt, and pepper and stir until cheese is melted and mixture is smooth.

4. Remove from heat and stir in chopped parsley. Serve warm.
